## DateTime.AddZone

```m
DateTime.AddZone(dateTime as nullable datetime, timezoneHours as number, optional timezoneMinutes as nullable number) as nullable datetimezone
```

Category: DateTime · hosts: desktop

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

| `timezoneMinutes` | `nullable number` | yes |

## DateTime.FixedLocalNow

```m
DateTime.FixedLocalNow() as datetime
```

Category: DateTime · hosts: desktop

Returns the current date and time in the local timezone. This value is fixed and will not change with successive calls.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/datetime-fixedlocalnow)
